column2: ʾidh nādāhu rabbuhu bilwādi l-muqaddasi ṭuwā
Faqul hal laka ʾilā ʾan tazakkā
ʾinna fi dhālika laʿibratan liman yakhshā
ʾaʾantum ʾashaddu khalqan ʾami s-samāʾu banāhā
Waʾammā man khāfa maqāma rabbihi wanahā n-nafsa ʿani l-hawā
Kaʾannahum yawma yarawnahā lam yalbathū ʾillā ʿashiyyatan ʾaw ḍuḥāhā
